movies.title: The Hidden Truth
movies.shortDesc: A long-sealed courtroom transcript unearths a web of silence in a coastal harbor town.
movies.synopsis: When an archivist in an Atlantic fishing port discovers an uncatalogued transcript from the winter of 1968, she begins tracing the fate of an investigative journalist who disappeared without a trace.
movies.editorialNote: Shot on 35mm Kodak Vision3 film with an evocative chamber orchestra score.

movies.title: The Last Promise
movies.shortDesc: Separated by borders, two musicians exchange unsent letters across three decades.
movies.synopsis: Spanning from the mid-1980s in Central Europe to modern-day Vienna, Richter weaves a bittersweet meditation on artistic sacrifice, fidelity, and the echoes of youth.
movies.editorialNote: A profound study in emotional restraint, celebrated by international critics.
